WEBVTT
00:00:00.000 --> 00:00:04.000 Hello, Odoo Support, how can I help you today?
00:00:05.000 --> 00:00:10.000 Hi, I'm having some trouble with the inventory valuation report. It doesn't seem to match my accounting.
00:00:11.000 --> 00:00:16.000 I see. Are you using Automated or Manual Inventory Valuation?
00:00:17.000 --> 00:00:22.000 We switched to Automated last month, but some old products still seem to behave differently.
00:00:23.000 --> 00:00:29.000 That might be because the Category settings only apply to new transactions. We should check the historical moves.
00:00:30.000 --> 00:00:35.000 Okay, how do I do that? Can you walk me through the steps?
00:00:36.000 --> 00:00:42.000 Sure. First, go to Inventory > Reporting > Stock Moves. We'll filter by product category and date.
00:00:43.000 --> 00:00:48.000 I'm there. I see a lot of 'Initial Inventory' lines from when we started.
00:00:49.000 --> 00:00:54.000 Exactly. Those probably didn't generate accounting entries if they were created before the switch.

WEBVTT
00:00:00.000 --> 00:00:02.500 Hello, Mitchell Admin speaking. How can I help you today?
00:00:03.000 --> 00:00:06.000 Hi Mitchell, this is Marc Demo. I'm calling about the new Odoo 18 features.
00:00:06.500 --> 00:00:09.000 Excellent! We have a lot of exciting updates. What specifically are you interested in?
00:00:09.500 --> 00:00:13.000 I heard there's a new Call Debrief widget. Can you tell me more about how it handles transcripts?
00:00:13.500 --> 00:00:17.000 Absolutely. The new widget allows you to play back call recordings while simultaneously viewing the transcription.
00:00:17.500 --> 00:00:20.500 That sounds incredibly useful for QA. Does it highlight the text as the audio plays?
00:00:21.000 --> 00:00:24.000 Yes, it does! As the playhead moves, the corresponding line in the transcript is highlighted.
00:00:24.500 --> 00:00:27.500 And if I click on a specific sentence in the transcript, what happens?
00:00:28.000 --> 00:00:31.000 Clicking a line will instantly seek the audio player to that exact moment in the recording.
00:00:31.500 --> 00:00:34.500 Wow, that will save our support managers so much time. No more scrubbing through audio manually.
00:00:35.000 --> 00:00:38.000 Exactly. It also supports keyboard shortcuts, so you can navigate the transcript using the up and down arrow keys.
00:00:38.500 --> 00:00:41.000 Wait, really? So I can just press the down arrow and it jumps to the next sentence?
00:00:41.500 --> 00:00:44.000 Yes! And it will automatically scroll the transcript container to keep the active line centered on your screen.
00:00:44.500 --> 00:00:47.000 That auto-scroll feature... I hope it doesn't scroll the entire web page along with it?
00:00:47.500 --> 00:00:50.000 Don't worry, we specifically isolated the scroll behavior. Only the transcript box itself will scroll.
00:00:50.500 --> 00:00:53.000 That is a massive relief. The UX team really thought this through. What about the database architecture?
00:00:53.500 --> 00:00:56.000 We introduced a new model called `mail.call.artifact` to handle the chunking and metadata cleanly.
00:00:56.500 --> 00:00:58.000 Fascinating. Well, this has been incredibly informative. I think we are ready to upgrade.
00:00:58.200 --> 00:00:59.000 Glad to hear it! I'll send over the documentation shortly. Have a great rest of your day, Marc.
00:00:59.200 --> 00:01:00.000 Thanks, Mitchell. You too. Bye!
